title: mark_delivered and complete_delivery undocumented distinction risks misuse
description: mark_delivered's docstring says only 'Mark as successfully delivered: delete the outbox row.' It does not state that it does NOT update messages.delivery_state — the critical difference from complete_delivery. A caller reading only the docstring would not know which one to use. Either add a doc warning to mark_delivered or make it private (it is only called from outbox tests and appears unused outside the crate).
